description: Unit tests for ELF-related classes and functions in google_breakpad's synth_elf module, including StringTable, SymbolTable, ELF header, section headers, program headers, and ELF notes.

classes.name: StringTableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for StringTable class, testing string addition, contents, and duplicate handling.

classes.name: SymbolTableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for SymbolTable class, testing symbol addition and serialization.

classes.name: BasicElf
classes.description: Templated test fixture for ELF header and section structure tests for 32-bit and 64-bit classes.

classes.name: ElfNotesTest
classes.description: Test fixture for ELF notes, testing empty and populated notes.

methods.name: StringTableTest
methods.description: Constructor for StringTableTest, initializes StringTable with little endian.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Tests that an empty StringTable has size 1 and only contains the null string.

methods.name: Basic
methods.description: Tests adding multiple strings to StringTable and verifies contents and label offsets.

methods.name: Duplicates
methods.description: Tests that adding duplicate strings returns the same label and contents are correct.

methods.name: Simple32
methods.description: Tests SymbolTable creation, symbol addition, and serialization for 32-bit ELF.

methods.name: BasicElf
methods.description: Templated class for testing ELF headers and sections for 32-bit and 64-bit classes.

methods.name: EmptyLE
methods.description: Tests ELF header and section headers for an empty little-endian ELF file.

methods.name: BasicLE
methods.description: Tests ELF with sections and segments, verifying headers and offsets for little-endian ELF.

methods.name: ElfNotesTest
methods.description: Tests ELF notes, including empty notes and notes with data.
